evidence.summary: PersistentDatasetRegistry defaults to schema archon-trading-data-registry-v2 and stores v2 dataset artifact paths/checksums while preserving serde defaults for v1 readability.
Migration handles v1 registries, upgrades records to v2, fills validation/manifest/raw artifact contract paths, fails closed by degrading metadata, and reports backup path/idempotent v2 state.
Registry writes use atomic temp replacement with backup when registry.json exists; data root is fixed at .archon/trading-lab/data and registry path is .archon/trading-lab/data/registry.json.

Existing data_store tests cover v2 registry schema, required artifacts metadata.json/ohlcv.jsonl/raw provider artifacts/validation.json/manifest.json, v1 migration backup, idempotency, and incomplete artifact fail-closed behavior.
CLI data status/list/show/export/ingest routes call TradingDataLake status/load/store/export paths and parse tests cover ingest, list, export, validation/provider commands.
